mechanism_narrative: A lower level of the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) compresses the discount rate for equity valuation, leading to higher S&P 500 forward 20-day returns.
failure_condition: Rank IC for FEDFUNDS predicting 20-day SPX returns is below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in low-rate periods (FEDFUNDS < 0.5%) are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A decline in the unemployment rate below 5.0% signals a tightening labor market, which typically precedes stronger corporate earnings and positive S&P 500 forward 20-day returns.
failure_condition: Rank IC for UNRATE predicting 20-day SPX returns is below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in low-unemployment periods (UNRATE < 5.0%) are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A combination of strong industrial production (INDPRO > 105) and low inflation (CPIAUCSL < 235) indicates a 'Goldilocks' economic environment with stable growth and low inflation, which typically leads to positive S&P 500 forward 20-day returns.
failure_condition: Rank IC for the joint condition INDPRO > 105 and CPIAUCSL < 235 predicting 20-day SPX returns is below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in the Goldilocks zone are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).
